title: Calibrate and pin a spring-loaded rotary spreader hopper gate at Setting 4
instruction: Set the spreader's gate to Setting 4 and pin it there, then let go.
context: More than 1.2 million US landscaping, groundskeeping, and agricultural workers calibrate rotary broadcast spreaders for fertilizer, seed, and ice melt by opening a spring-returned metering slide gate to a numbered flow rate setting and dropping a locking stop pin into the calibrated slot against spring tension before releasing.
setup: Station tabletop (z = TOP = 0.7475 m) with bimanual 6-DoF YAM arms (94 mm parallel-jaw grippers, bases at (0.0, +/-0.305, 0.75) m in READY pose). Fixed 1:1 rotary spreader hopper gate assembly (18.0 x 14.0 x 10.0 cm overall envelope) centered at (0.295, 0.0, TOP) m: dark powder-coated steel base plate and guide rails, open-top green hopper funnel throat filled with visible granular fertilizer pellets, a calibrated 0-6 cm front rate scale (Setting 4 highlighted green at 4.0 cm; > 5.2 cm marked red), a bright yellow upper clevis bridge with a 20 x 20 mm vertical pin bore at x = 0.247 m, y = -/+0.015 m (randomized via SIDE=L|R), and a spring-returned horizontal stainless slide gate (0.18 kg PrismaticJoint along Y, 0.0 to 6.5 cm travel, return spring k = 70.0 N/m, damping = 4.0 N*s/m pulling toward 0.0 cm closed) with a 26 mm Setting 4 slot, orange scale pointer, and orange T-grip pull handle extending at y = +/-0.118 m. On the opposite side sits a fixed 6.4 x 6.4 x 5.2 cm dark steel pin staging stand at (0.247, -/+0.185, TOP) m holding a 0.10 kg steel-and-red locking stop pin (10 x 10 x 44 mm shaft, 28 x 28 x 8 mm stop collar resting at z = TOP + 0.052 m, and 28 x 14 x 26 mm red T-knob grip).
scoring: Evaluated at episode end (SCORE_OVER = end). Any hazard condition (over-opening the slide gate past Setting 5 (> 5.2 cm) or dropping stop_pin > 1.5 cm below tabletop for 2 consecutive steps) latches score to 0.0. Without hazards: 0.25 if the gate is slid open to [3.2, 5.2] cm; 0.50 if the gate is held in [3.5, 4.9] cm and stop_pin is lifted off the staging stand; 0.75 if the gate rests at 4.0 +/- 0.4 cm ([3.6, 4.4] cm) and stop_pin is seated upright (tilt <= 10.0 deg) inside the Setting 4 clevis bore (|dx|, |dy| <= 1.0 cm, |dz| <= 6 mm of clevis bridge top); 1.0 if both gate (4.0 +/- 0.4 cm, |vel| <= 0.005 m/s) and seated stop_pin (<= 0.005 m/s, <= 5.0 deg/s, or < 2 mm / < 1 deg drift over 1.0 s) remain still with both grippers clear of hopper_gate, gate, and stop_pin (<= 2 mm contact margin) for 1.0 s (20 steps at 20 Hz).
reset_notes: Between trials, extract stop_pin from the clevis bore and return it upright to pin_stand at (0.247, -/+0.185, TOP + 0.052) m, let the spring-returned slide gate close to 0.0 cm, select SIDE (L or R), and return both YAM arms to READY.
fidelity: PhysX at 240 Hz on the dual YAM rig. The hopper gate is an anchored prismatic joint on a spring-damper (70 N/m, 4 N s/m) returning to closed, with clevis and slot colliders that hold it once the rigid stop pin is inserted. Granular spill on over-opening (above 5.2 cm) is a latched threshold check, not particle flow. Gate and pin are rigid and idealised.
